title: When Online Adaptation of Resilience Policies Hurts: Safe Exploration and Measurement Pitfalls in Resilience4j
abstract: arXiv:2611.32015v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Circuit breaker, retry, and bulkhead settings in Java microservices are tuned once and frozen, although the best setting depends on the fault a dependency is currently showing. We study whether an online learner can pick these settings at runtime. AdaptR4j swaps Resilience4j policies atomically in Spring Boot 3 and lets a contextual bandit choose among complete CircuitBreaker/Retry/Bulkhead configurations from Prometheus signals. Our first, naive design scored worse than keeping the default policy in three of four winnable fault scenarios under the reward it optimised: exploring a menu that contained aggressive circuit breakers rejected most traffic while the learner was still learning. Two safeguards fix this: a safe policy menu (no breaker stricter than the latency SLO) and safe exploration with a bounded reward. translated_title: 当弹性策略的在线自适应适得其反时：Resilience4j中的安全探索与测量陷阱
translated_abstract: Java微服务中的熔断器、重试和舱壁设置通常只调优一次便被冻结，然而最佳设置实际上取决于依赖服务当前表现出的故障类型。我们研究了在线学习器能否在运行时选择这些设置。AdaptR4j在Spring Boot 3中原子性地切换Resilience4j策略，并让上下文赌博机根据Prometheus信号在完整的熔断器/重试/舱壁配置菜单中进行选择。我们的第一个朴素设计在其所优化的奖励指标下，在四个可赢得的故障场景中有三个的表现反而不如保持默认策略：在学习器仍处于学习阶段时，探索包含激进熔断器的配置菜单导致大部分流量被拒绝。两个安全保障措施解决了这一问题：一是安全策略菜单（不包含比延迟SLO更严格的熔断器配置），二是带有有界奖励的安全探索。有了这些措施，AdaptR4j在每一个可赢得的场景中都胜过了生产默认配置（p < 0.001，每个场景三次运行，运行间标准差 <=
tldr: 该论文提出AdaptR4j系统，利用上下文赌博机在运行时动态选择Resilience4j的熔断器/重试/舱壁策略，并通过安全策略菜单和有界奖励的安全探索两项保障机制，克服了朴素在线学习在探索阶段拒绝流量的陷阱，在所有可赢得的故障场景中超越生产默认配置。
en_tdlr: AdaptR4j uses a contextual bandit to dynamically select Resilience4j CircuitBreaker/Retry/Bulkhead policies at runtime, and with two safeguards—a safe policy menu and safe exploration with bounded reward—it avoids the pitfall of naive online learners rejecting traffic during exploration and outperforms the production default in every winnable fault scenario.
